detail.title: INTEX AIR KING HC 55 Air Cooler – 55 Litres
detail.overview: Long Air Throw | Inverter-Compatible | Ice Chamber | 1-Year Warranty Overview The Intex Air King HC 55 Desert Air Cooler is built to deliver reliable and efficient desert cooling for small to mid-sized rooms, making it an ideal choice for bedrooms, cabins, study rooms, and compact living areas. Designed to perform in hot and dry summer conditions, this cooler combines strong air delivery with energy-efficient operation, ensuring consistent comfort throughout the day. With a 55-litre water tank, the Air King HC 55 supports extended cooling hours without frequent refilling. It features a 16-inch fan paired with a 3-speed air delivery system, ensuring effective airflow and wide coverage across the room. The 3-sided honeycomb cooling pads enhance water retention and evaporation, delivering up to 25% extra cooling for faster temperature reduction. During extreme heat, the dedicated ice chamber allows users to intensify the cooling effect instantly. Built for durability and everyday convenience, the Air King HC 55 comes with a shock- and rust-proof body designed for long-lasting seasonal use. Its low power consumption makes it highly energy efficient, while full inverter compatibility ensures uninterrupted operation during power cuts and voltage fluctuations. Equipped with 360-degree castor wheels, the cooler offers easy mobility, allowing it to be positioned wherever cooling is needed most. Compact yet powerful, the Air King HC 55 delivers dependable desert cooling with efficiency and flexibility. Product Highlights 55-Litre Water Tank for Continuous Cooling Provides ample water capacity for long hours of uninterrupted desert cooling in everyday living spaces. Energy-Efficient 190W Operation Designed for low power consumption while delivering effective cooling, helping reduce electricity costs. High-Efficiency 3-Side Honeycomb Pads Improve water retention and evaporation, resulting in faster cooling and enhanced air freshness. Instant Cooling with Ice Chamber The built-in ice chamber allows quick temperature drop during peak summer heat. Inverter-Compatible for Uninterrupted Comfort Ensures smooth operation during power cuts and voltage fluctuations. Easy Mobility with 360° Castor Wheels Allows effortless movement and flexible placement across rooms. Ideal For: Large bedrooms, substantial living rooms, or medium-sized offices. They balance high capacity with ease of mobility, perfect for general home use in dry climates.
